says: Reading the profile first (access.profile.read) shows it active at access generation 1, its first use, opened by the device key. A person with a bound repository and a committed instructions source has a read of that source sealed at generation 1, admitted and held in flight while they lock the profile (access.transition lock: locked, generation 2); the in-flight read is rechecked before its result is shown and is not admitted, with access_locked and access_generation_moved, so no stale body reaches the now-locked scope. The locked entry (surface.drive from the locked scope entrance) shows only that the profile is locked, how to unlock at a terminal, and an unlock action; Down, Tab and Enter move nothing and unlock nothing, and every frame stays access locked with nothing dispatched or called. An unlock naming no explicit method is refused at admission (variant_mismatch /change). The person unlocks explicitly with the device key at a terminal (active again, still generation 2: only a restriction moves the generation); the same old read, still sealed at generation 1, is again not admitted (access_generation_moved) rather than delivered into the reopened session, while the same read sealed afresh at generation 2 for the same actor and repository is allowed. The person then signs out (access.transition sign_out: signed out, generation 3); the signed-out entry (surface.drive from the locked scope entrance) shows only that the profile is signed out and how to sign back in at a terminal, and a Down key moves and signs nothing back in: the frame stays access signed_out with nothing dispatched or called. Negative: no frame shows the source's path, title, counts or repository name while locked or signed out; navigation never changes access or signs back in; and the late read never becomes admitted under the new generation.
